question_text:
Multi-Pattern Intrusion Detection

You are building an intrusion detection system (IDS) that monitors a large stream of network traffic (represented as a text string T) for a set of known attack signature patterns. Each pattern may appear in the traffic stream multiple times.

Given K patterns and a text string T, count the number of occurrences of each pattern in T (overlapping occurrences count).

Input: First line is K (number of patterns). Next K lines are the patterns. Last line is the text T.

Output K lines, where the i-th line is the count of pattern i in text T.
explanation: This is solved with Aho-Corasick Algorithm. Build a trie from all patterns. Then compute failure links (similar to KMP failure function) via BFS. Each failure link points to the longest proper suffix of the current trie path that is also a prefix of some pattern. During text traversal, follow trie edges (or failure links if edge missing). At each position, emit all patterns that end at the current state via output links. Time Complexity: O(sum of pattern lengths + |T| + total matches).
